description: Defines a 'smart_holder' class for managing C++ object lifetimes and interoperability with Python, supporting unique_ptr and shared_ptr conversions, type erasure, and custom deleters, within the pybind11 library.

classes.name: smart_holder
classes.description: A type-erased holder for C++ objects supporting various smart pointer interops, designed for safe Python bindings.

methods.name: from_raw_ptr_unowned
methods.description: Creates a smart_holder from a raw pointer without ownership.

methods.name: from_raw_ptr_take_ownership
methods.description: Creates a smart_holder from a raw pointer with ownership, optionally casting to void*.

methods.name: disown
methods.description: Disowns the managed object, preventing deletion.

methods.name: reclaim_disowned
methods.description: Reclaims a disowned object, restoring ownership.

methods.name: release_disowned
methods.description: Releases ownership of the managed object.

methods.name: from_unique_ptr
methods.description: Creates a smart_holder from a std::unique_ptr, managing lifetime.

methods.name: from_shared_ptr
methods.description: Creates a smart_holder from a std::shared_ptr.

methods.name: as_shared_ptr
methods.description: Returns a std::shared_ptr to the managed object.
